**Exit:** `qops run download --source synthetic` makes a verified snapshot, and in the app BUD lists two securities and a split shows its ±20-day window; TC-01–TC-04, TC-06–TC-10, TC-19, TC-21, TC-22 pass.
**Covers:** SNAP-01–SNAP-08, PRICE-01–PRICE-08, UNIV-01–UNIV-06, LOAD-01–LOAD-07, DATA-07, APP-01–APP-05, APP-11, QR-07–QR-10 · **Deferred:** DATA-01–DATA-05, DATA-09 (to M2: the Sharadar adapter waits on PB-01), UNIV-07 (to M2: exit codes come from PB-01 C6), APP-06, APP-08–APP-10, QR-05 (to M2: flags and runs from the app arrive with validation), APP-07 (to M3: flag overview), QR-01–QR-03, QR-11 (to M3: timed on a real snapshot)
**Skills:** frontend-design (visual direction, security page), dataviz (theme palette, price chart)
